title: Sell the Last Unit Once
description: Two requests read stock=1 before either writes. Each promises a sale. Which single-row operation makes the availability check and decrement one database decision?

options.explanation: Another request can still change it between the last read and write.

options.text: Read stock from a shorter-TTL cache.
options.explanation: A fresher copy is still not an atomic check-and-change on the authoritative row.

options.text: Sleep randomly between the read and write.
options.explanation: Timing may change the race's frequency but does not enforce the invariant.

options.text: UPDATE stock SET qty=qty-1 WHERE id=? AND qty>0; check affected rows.
options.explanation: The conditional update lets one request decrement the last unit and gives the loser zero affected rows. It avoids an application-level read-check-write race.
